edit.description: Middle emphasis with positive guidance throughout; same M2 reward
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: The mid-window emphasis schedule does not improve the primary final predicted affinity metric relative to the incumbent M2 dose, or degrades it.
The rise-then-fall soft-mass shape is not reproducible across independent batches (clone dependence / batch inconsistency), so the mid-window emphasis is not a stable target.

Realized-dose auditing shows the per-seed flow scales or safety caps prevent the intended mean-one normalized dose profile from being delivered, so the compiled table change does not actually alter the executed trace.
Secondary checks fail: structural validity or strain worsens even if affinity is unchanged, or the changed trajectory produces invalid chemistry.
The sign-change/strong-sign-conflict counts in the displacement curves are not reproducible in independent batches, removing the basis for rejecting a monotone-trend schedule.
rationale: H002 is the only hypothesis whose observed feature shape (soft-mass occupancy proxies rising then falling over the observed score window, cited via the landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_10_soft_mass curve handles) points to a specific registered temporal intervention: W2_middle_peak, which concentrates the dose ratio budget mid-window (dose [0.5,1.5,0.5] at knots [0,0.5,1]) while preserving the M2 reward, delta and mixture. H001's displacement curves (landmark_00 and landmark_10 local_dx/dy/dz) show non-monotone, sign-changing trajectories with many strong sign conflicts, which rules out any monotone-trend assumption but does not by itself identify a dose direction; it is adopted only as the constraint that the schedule must not assume a single monotone coordinate trend and must keep total delivered displacement fixed, which W2_middle_peak satisfies via mean-one normalization. W1_early_soft and W3_early_strong_control are the opposite time-order controls and are not supported by the mid-window peak shape. This is a dose-route edit only; delta, temperatures, teacher settings and eta remain frozen, and no affinity benefit is claimed from coordinate proxies alone.
